description: This file manages the display and interaction logic for connected devices, including online and offline devices, in a network management web interface. It includes PHP code to gather device information, generate HTML tables, and embed JavaScript for dynamic UI behavior.

methods.name: ProcessLay1Interface
methods.description: Determines the network type and connection type based on the Layer1Interface string, distinguishing Wi-Fi, Ethernet, MoCA, or Unknown.

methods.name: get_hotspot_clients
methods.description: Retrieves the list of clients associated with a specific hotspot SSID, including their MAC, hostname, RSSI, IPv4, and IPv6 addresses.
